description: Three 3/2 core frames with an LFE channel of the 128 times interpolation, sum/difference front and surround channels, joint intensity coding (the surround channels copy the front ones above their own bandwidth), a sync word after every subsubframe and subframes of 2, 1, 3 and 2 subsubframes, without prediction or vector quantization.

skip.libdca: libdca 0.0.7 does not decode joint intensity coding: it prints 'Joint stereo coding not supported' and rejects every frame (measured with Ubuntu's libdca 0.0.7); ffmpeg decodes the frames
